# Search and citations

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/retrieval`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/retrieval.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/answer` | Search, ask the model with numbered sources, verify citations (abstains when unsupported). | `AnswerRequest` | 200 `AnswerOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/citations/verify` | Strip fabricated or unsupported citations; abstain when none remain. | `AnswerIn` | 200 `VerificationOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/index/collections/{collection_id}` | Delete Collection |  | 200 `Deleted` |
| `GET` | `/v1/index/collections/{collection_id}/stats` | Stats |  | 200 `CollectionStats` |
| `PUT` | `/v1/index/documents/{document_id}` | Replace a document's whole tree atomically. | `DocumentIn` | 200 `IndexResult` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/index/documents/{document_id}` | Mark a document outdated (left out of answers) or current again. | `DocumentFlags` | 200 `FlagsOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/index/documents/{document_id}` | Delete Document |  | 200 `Deleted` |
| `GET` | `/v1/index/documents/{document_id}/outline` | The indexed tree of a document, in reading order (no text or vectors). |  | 200 `Outline` |
| `POST` | `/v1/search` | Hybrid search over the caller's visible content, expanded to cited sections. | `SearchIn` | 200 `SearchOut` |
